vibe: A former visual effects artist who builds J.A.R.V.I.S.-style visual agents and calm hardware, and documents as he goes.
lines: My week 1 newcomer just wanted friends. The local Qwen kept talking to the lying florist, hoping they'd make up their mind, and hit the 25-step cap.
I built glyph, a credit card wallet with an e-ink screen. Now Zora can ask me yes or no questions on it.
Zora lives in my Obsidian vault. About 1,400 small git commits so far, so her mistakes are reversible.
Week 5: 10 of 17 runs blew past the word limit. I'd call that mixed results.
I used to work in visual effects on films like Iron Man. J.A.R.V.I.S. is still a bit of an inspiration.
Group 2 gave the course agent memory. One saved preference and it explained machine learning with a newsroom example.
Known bug: submit the questionnaire twice and it remembers everything twice.
